title: Mouse sensorimotor cortex reflects complex kinematic details during reaching and grasping
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Decode all 24 forelimb joint-angle trajectories from M1-fl and S1-fl neural activity for the original Figure 5 reaching/grasping task. Joint velocities, lagged variants and optogenetic disruption are separate analyses.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Decode all 24 forelimb joint-angle trajectories from M1-fl and S1-fl neural activity for the original Figure 5 reaching/grasping task. Joint velocities, lagged variants and optogenetic disruption are separate analyses.

Source-paper comparison for Figure 5 held-out variance explained per joint and source mouse/area summary: For every joint and held-out fold, VE = 1 - Var(y - yhat)/Var(y), with MATLAB sample-variance semantics over concatenated test-trial timepoints. Higher is better. This differs from 1 - SSE/SST when residual means are nonzero.
success_criteria: Recover the numeric original Figure 5 score panel and reproduce the source author decoder on all ten sessions and all 24 joints.
Bind original folds, RADICaL inputs, cell selection, PCA exposure and exact source VE formula before candidate iteration.
Predeclare the source-summary comparison and meaningful effect/uncertainty so a favorable subset of joints, mice or areas cannot establish success.
A lower reconstruction error to saved figures, a gain over the local phase template, a new split or the separate optogenetic histogram does not establish a source-paper win.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.

lineage_and_loader_evidence.source_bridge: Figshare inventory contains ten neural/kinematic MAT recordings, event timing, and two optogenetic MAT files. Author loadData.m loads R/M structures using documented mouse/session filenames; loadLock4Decode and decode.m transform those trials into the decoding analysis. Documentation specifies per-trial neural activity and 3D joint metadata.

episode.improvement_loop: Blocked pending the original score panel and matched source route. Subsequent method iteration must use training and designated validation feedback under the declared source input condition.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze all trial identifiers, cell-selection and PCA choices, source fold manifest, candidate method, original summary comparison and uncertainty rule before final scoring.
episode.final_evaluation: Compare both methods on identical original folds and all eligible mouse/area/joint outputs; retain per-mouse paired results and source figure reductions. New held-animal evaluation is an extension.
episode.baseline_policy: The author ridge/RADICaL decoder is the baseline. The locally authored phase template is a diagnostic control, not the published method, and has no authority to define paper victory.
